propositions: A gateway/* provider (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) with no base_url is incorrectly stamped as tier first_class instead of best_effort, misrepresenting provenance in signed verdicts.

The tier derivation logic in capabilities.py checks only base_url but omits the gateway/* provider family, allowing intermediary rewrites (documented by Vercel AI Gateway precedent) to be hidden from provenance consumers.
Direct providers without base_url must continue to stamp tier first_class; only gateway/* providers should force tier best_effort regardless of base_url presence.
endpoint_host should remain None for gateway providers unless base_url is explicitly configured, since it reports what was actually set rather than synthesizing values from provider ids.
